policy: Every human-readable source in the authoritative prior-attempt archive must have an explicit best-of disposition. Objective mechanics and engineering are preserved or independently re-proved; useful semantics become exact-state-derived features/tests; historical strategy is never imported as target truth merely because it existed.

best_of: package/API intent and module boundary of the neural DeepSpin attempt
preserve: clear separation between environment, traversal, networks, buffers and trainer
entries.destination: architecture provenance only; current SpinCore package boundaries supersede it
never_inherit_as_truth: module presence as evidence of strategic correctness

preserve: deterministic memory state and exact checkpoint restoration
never_inherit_as_truth: old buffer contents or old learned samples

preserve: observations must be derived from a legally reached authoritative state
legal-action mask must come from the engine
path-dependent context must come from ordered events
entries.destination: core solver state, NeuralInput V1/V2 and R7.5 reachability certification
never_inherit_as_truth: old observation layout as immutable production truth

best_of: history and status fields exposed at the engine boundary
preserve: typed separation of authoritative state from learning code
entries.destination: current C++ solver/C ABI state boundary

preserve: build/runtime provenance must be explicit and testable
entries.destination: CI CMake/build manifests and immutable workflow execution
never_inherit_as_truth: old Python/Windows build artifact as production binary

preserve: illegal actions must be excluded from both inference and loss
advantage and policy roles remain distinct
entries.destination: R7.5 representation models and R7.5.4 ten-action heads
never_inherit_as_truth: old network width as strategic optimum

preserve: distributed work must carry explicit episode/task provenance
worker outputs must remain legal-mask constrained
entries.destination: R7/R8 workflow and worker provenance/parallel training
never_inherit_as_truth: old worker scheduling as a strategic parameter

preserve: scenario generation must be reproducible and legal
sampling RNG must not be silently coupled to model initialization
entries.destination: frozen R7/R8 seeds, exact Episode construction and scenario gates
never_inherit_as_truth: old stack distribution if not part of current frozen profile

preserve: stop/restore/continue must reproduce uninterrupted execution
checkpoint must contain all stochastic state
entries.destination: R7.5.4 ten-action checkpoint/resume and R8 production training
never_inherit_as_truth: old checkpoint weights or old stopping outcome

preserve: traversal must move through legal game states
replay identity must be tied to exact episode/action path
entries.destination: current partial-exact CFR traversal and paired/reachability audits
never_inherit_as_truth: old sampling estimator if it conflicts with frozen recovered estimator

preserve: runtime state must be validated before strategic inference
state-reading faults must be separable from strategy faults
entries.destination: R10 OpenHoldem runtime parity and R12 operational diagnostics

preserve: objective concepts only when deterministically derivable from exact state/history
candidate action sizes are empirical research candidates, not assumed optimal
entries.destination: R7.5 representation features, R7.5.4 action abstraction, R11 exploitation vocabulary

preserve: use as semantic coverage/oracle checklist for objective card-state facts
entries.destination: R7.5 semantic feature tests/corpus coverage; later runtime diagnostics

preserve: diagnostics must first prove what state the bot believed before blaming strategy
entries.destination: R10 runtime parity and R12 table-readiness diagnostics
never_inherit_as_truth: OpenHoldem-symbol interpretation without validation against authoritative state

preserve: use as regression/reference corpus for canonicalization and coverage
entries.destination: R7.5 flop-abstraction candidate validation and canonicalization regression

preserve: cross-check JSON mapping completeness and provide interpretable historical class labels
never_inherit_as_truth: historical label taxonomy as a fixed neural target

preserve: canonicalization test cases
solver-process observability
safe failure rather than silent strategic substitution
exact hand/board/path validation
entries.destination: R7.5 canonicalization regression plus R10 solver/runtime integration diagnostics
never_inherit_as_truth: inferred path when exact trajectory exists
